hero.title: Save together. Govern together. Grow together.
hero.subtitle: CircleUp is the trusted home for ROSCAs, susus, tandas, paluwagans, and welfare funds — built with diaspora communities, for diaspora communities.

discover.title: What is a ROSCA?
discover.body: A Rotating Savings and Credit Association is a group of trusted members who pool fixed contributions and take turns receiving the full pot. No interest, no banks, just discipline and trust.

discover.title: Susu, tanda, paluwagan, tontine
discover.body: Same idea, different names. CircleUp speaks your community's language and follows your governance traditions — not the other way around.

discover.title: Trust Score makes risk visible
discover.body: Every member earns a 0–1000 Trust Score based on payment history, identity verification, and engagement. You see exactly how it's calculated.

discover.title: Emergency Fund covers defaults
discover.body: 1% of every contribution feeds an Emergency Fund. If a member can't pay, the fund covers the cycle. No drama, no broken trust.
